services.title: Winch-out and recovery
services.body: If it has come off the road or dropped a wheel, we run the line out and bring it back up before anything is loaded.
services.alt: Old rusted cabover truck out on the road seen past the cab of the recovery truck.
services.evidence: Old rusted cabover truck out on the road seen past the cab of the recovery truck.

services.title: Car and light truck transport
services.body: Cars, pickups and vans ride flat on the deck and are chained at the points the manufacturer put there for it.
services.alt: Long gooseneck trailer with its loading ramps folded out onto the asphalt.
services.evidence: Silver sedan strapped down on the flatbed at the side of a tree lined road.

services.title: Heavy and oversize loads
services.body: Anything that will sit on a deck can move on one, from plant and trailers to whole buildings.
services.alt: The company recovery truck with chrome exhaust stacks parked out on the road.
services.evidence: White dual rear wheel pickup with its headlights on towing a loaded trailer across a dirt

services.title: Night and out of hours calls
services.body: Breakdowns do not keep office hours, and a good part of this work happens in the dark.
services.evidence: Green forklift chained down on the flatbed deck at night.

reviews.author: Lathan Fann
reviews.text: If you need a vehicle towed, NextLoad Towing and Recovery is who you need to call! They helped me out and got two cars towed across two counties all in one day. They did a fantastic job and even dropped them off at the new location exactly how I requested. I will for sure without a doubt be using them again in the near future!

reviews.author: Steven
reviews.text: Called Next Load to tow my truck in to local shop for repairs. The owner was very friendly and extremely reasonable on his price, compared to other local tow companies. I would highly recommend Next Load for any towing need someone might have.

reviews.author: Vester Powell
reviews.text: Their the ones you need to call, great and reliable service. Garrett did a awesome job. He treated my car just like it was his, couldn't ask for anything better

reviews.author: krea reed
reviews.text: Experience was quick, professional, and made the whole towing process smooth and stress-free. Towed two cars at a very affordable price. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Goodsoup Campbell
reviews.text: Excellent customer service. Very reliable and dependable. Took great care in transporting my vehicle and even offered a ride to my drop off location to save money on an Uber. Will definitely use this company again and refer to a friend.

reviews.author: Danny Pittman
reviews.text: Nextload transported my Bentley to Charlotte NC. I was impressed by the way they handled my automobile. I recommend them to transport your vehicle knowing they are reliable and trustworthy to use. I will be using them again and I think you should to.

reviews.author: David Cox
reviews.text: Outstanding people and a pleasure to do business with. Always on time and very dependable. Mr. Robinson has transported well over 40 vehicles for me without incident. Very satisfied with not only the price but the service. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Ray Lebourdais
reviews.text: I purchased a 2 post auto lift from Amgo lifts in Manning, SC. I contracted Nextload to deliver it to me in Benson, NC. I needed it fast and Garrett made it happen! He went above and beyond every step of the way. Communication was immediate! All my concerns were addressed. The entire experience was a pleasure! Nextload had the knowledge, experience, and the necessarry equipment to move my lift from door to door without so much as a hicup! I you need something shipped, you owe it to yourself to give them a call! I COULD NOT BE HAPPIER! Thank you Garrett!

reviews.author: JB Stevens
reviews.text: Nextload, transported my Range Rover to Cary NC safely and promptly with no problems, very professional and truly affordable. I would definitely be using them again an highly recommended them.

reviews.author: Daniel Wooley
reviews.text: Great service. Careful with load/unload and even provided detailed pictures of before/after load/unload to ensure the car was taken care of. Will 10/10 recommend and use this service again.

reviews.author: Malik Tart
reviews.text: I had a very excellent experience. Very fast and did not mess my car up loading it .very nice and friendly. Great piece definitely recommend !!

reviews.author: Belinda Locklear
reviews.text: I was well please with the work Nextload Towing done for me and my family. Thank you Nextload Towing and Transportation. Job well done

reviews.author: Anya Wilkerson
reviews.text: Excellent and professional service, definitely get the job done in a timely manner and the prices are reasonable, will be using them again.

reviews.author: Al Collins
reviews.text: Very professional and knowledgeable when it came to completing the task!! I would highly recommend his services!

reviews.author: Mark Mesco
reviews.text: Garrett is the absolute best! My car died on I95 on the way to vacation, he got to us way quicker than other places were telling us and for a much more reasonable place. He told us during the tow he knew we were sitting out in the heat and made an effort to get there quicker. He also told me he knows some people in the area who could help with the repairs if the shop we took it to couldn’t fix the issue in time. Super nice and polite guy and great conversation on the trip. Can’t recommend enough!
